reviews.text: Ty was amazing and so helpful in teaching us how to communicate with and train our dog. After just the first session we already saw improvement in our dogs behavior (and she loved him!). And after final session, she's so much obedient and calm, and we feel like we have all of the tools to be the best owners for her. Highly recommend!

I did two weeks of board & train for my reactive dog Gracie. From the very beginning, all of the staff have been kind and professional and answered all my questions quickly through email. Gracie’s trainers, Ty and Kyle, have been absolutely wonderful. They have been so patient, compassionate, and understanding of her unique needs. Gracie can be nervous and reactive, so finding people who truly take the time to understand her and work at her pace has meant so much to us.

I received thorough updates and photos of Gracie’s progress throughout the week. It was so wonderful and encouraging to see Gracie blossom and gain confidence as time went on. Her training has given her the tools to navigate situations that would normally be overwhelming for her. Gracie went from not being able to see or pass a dog without reacting defensively out of fear, to actually making friends with other dogs, including relaxing on the couch without a muzzle next to her new friend Yellow. I’m so happy with how far Gracie has come with the help and love from her trainers. Just as importantly, they’ve given me the knowledge and support to better understand her and help her succeed by continuing her training at home.

I’m incredibly grateful for everything they’ve done for Gracie and for me. They genuinely care about the dogs they work with, and it shows in everything they do. I would wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone looking for patient, compassionate, and truly exceptional trainers.

We hired Bow Wow Behavioral because our dogs were a nightmare to walk due to constant pulling and eating things off the ground. We decided to board and train our dogs. The trainers, Ty, Kyle and Laura were great to work with and always gave us updates on the progression of training at the end of of every day. Ty was even concerned and informed us immediately when one of our dogs seemed to develop an ear infection during their training stay. When we picked up our dogs after training was over,  they taught myself and my husband training techniques for better behaved dogs on our walks. While my dogs are not perfect, they are 1000% better. Walks are definitely more relaxed and our dogs now walk on a loose leash without lunging ahead or eating things off the ground. I highly recommend their services.
Highly recommend for puppy training! We had great results with everything from basic commands to leash reactivity and separation anxiety, and saw noticeable progress very quickly.

We had a wonderful board and train experience with Ty and the trainer Kyle. Could not be happier.

Ty is warm and extremely knowledgeable. He has a passion for his work and it shows. Kyle sent us regular updates on our dogs progress. It is obvious that a lot of time went into her care.

We feel lucky to have found Bow Wow and look forward to using them in the future.

Our training with Ty was very effective and basically solved all our problems! We tried other trainers before Ty and none of those previous methods worked with our dog. He helped us stop our dog's barking when people walked by the door and also helped train her to not jump on people as they walked in. Most importantly, he helped us reduce her resource-guarding aggression through a ladder of desensitization methods. He explained everything clearly and gave us homework that was achievable each time. We are thrilled with his services!

This was such a positive experience for us and our 16 month old pup. Ty is so patient in teaching the dog parent how to be consistent so our pet understood what was expected. Ty showed us repetitive exercises at which to become proficient which made the walks outside much improved. He helped us with leash pulling and barking at other dogs. I would recommend Ty and his services to all.
Ty was so wonderful in getting my crazy puppy to become a behaved one. He was very responsive, detailed and made training feel easy.

Working with Ty, Laura, and Kyle helped my pup so much. She came from the shelter extremely scared of going outside, and through the board and train she was able to overcome that. She still needed additional help with leash training, but even one session with Ty transformed her behavior.

We have been using Bow Wow Behavioral for our first puppy, Milo, and now our second puppy, Lincoln. Milo is always told he is the best behaved puppy and I have Ty and team to credit for that! When we got Lincoln, we enrolled him in puppy training and also a week of camp, which is boarding with training for a week. We had an amazing experience - Ty, Laura, and Kyle are super knowledgeable, patient, responsive, and detailed. We received extensive updates everyday on Lincoln's training, cute pictures, and connections to puppy parents that he played well with. We felt like our pup was in the best hands and safe, which is all you really want! Lincoln came back and was able to walk so much better with us and was noticeably better trained. We will continue to use Bow Wow Behavioral for continuous training needs for both of our dogs - couldn't recommend the team more!

We first started working with Laura through individual training sessions in our apartment before sending our 3-year-old Sheepadoodle, Toby, for a 2-week board and train, and the experience exceeded our expectations.

We loved that Bow Wow's setup is an apartment environment similar to our own home, which made the transition easy for Toby. From day one, communication was outstanding. Kyle, Laura, and Ty sent detailed daily updates with photos, explaining what they worked on, what challenges came up, and how Toby responded. Reading those updates became the highlight of our day. They clearly understood Toby's specific tendencies (leash pulling, dog reactivity, nervousness around traffic) and tailored every session to address them.

The progress was remarkable. Toby went from needing a head lead on every walk to walking calmly through busy Chicago streets, past dogs, squirrels, kids, train stations, and even through Petco, all without it. Kyle gradually increased the difficulty each day, and when something was too challenging, she'd take a step back and work through it rather than pushing too hard.

Beyond the training, the whole team genuinely cared about Toby. When he had a stomach issue, Ty checked in the next morning to let us know he was feeling better. When we asked about paw licking, multiple team members responded within hours. They also set us up for success at home by explaining the "why" behind every technique so we could continue the work ourselves.

Highly recommend for anyone looking for real results and a team that treats your dog like their own. We're already planning follow-up sessions.

Ty was such a huge help to us! He was professional, knowledgeable, and kind. The at home training provided so many tools to help build our dog’s confidence and help him be more comfortable with guests. We saw improvements immediately! I would highly recommend working with Bow Wow Behavioral.

Our two dogs did a 7-day board & train stay at Bow Wow together, and I am so grateful for the care and attention they received there. They came back more bonded with one another, more confident, and seemingly eager to continue their training. Thanks Ty, Kyle, and Laura!
Ty is tremendous. After only a few sessions are dog's behaviour is so much better. He actually listens and is not aggressive wiith other dogs. Higly recommended .
We had a great experience working with Ty. Our dog made a lot of progress with potty training, leash training, and giving us personal space. Highly recommend.

The trainers are patient, knowledgeable, and passionate about helping dogs and their owners build a strong, positive relationship. They take the time to assess each dog’s unique personality and needs, tailoring training techniques that are effective and compassionate. Whether it’s basic obedience, leash manners, or more complex behavioral challenges, the progress is noticeable and lasting. The sessions are well-structured, engaging, and fun for both dogs and owners, making the learning process enjoyable and stress-free.

What truly sets Bow Wow Behavioral apart is the care and dedication they show toward every client. The trainers communicate clearly, provide ongoing support, and genuinely celebrate each milestone along the way. Their approach is rooted in respect, patience, and understanding — creating confidence for both pets and their people. The results speak for themselves: calmer, happier dogs and more confident owners. It’s rare to find a training service that blends expertise with such genuine love for animals. Bow Wow Behavioral is an exceptional choice for anyone looking to build trust, harmony, and lifelong skills with their dog.

I can’t say enough great things about Bow Wow Behavioral! I've done board & train and in home training and the progress George has made since starting with them has been incredible—he’s calmer, listens so much better, and our walks are actually enjoyable now. Ty, Kyle, and Laura are true pros who clearly love what they do. They take the time to explain things, tailor their approach to each dog, and celebrate every little win along the way. It’s been such a rewarding experience watching George grow with their guidance. If you’re looking for a team that’s knowledgeable, kind, and truly committed to helping dogs and their owners succeed, Bow Wow Behavioral is the one to call.

I’m so grateful for Ty! He was kind, patient, and genuinely cared about helping my dog, Stevie, settle into her new home. Walks that used to feel stressful are now calm and enjoyable, and I can see how much more confident Stevie has become and I feel more confident too. He made such a positive difference for both of us.

We’ve been working with Ty at Bow Wow Behavioral for almost a year, and we can’t say enough good things! Our 4-year-old rescue dog struggled with leash reactivity/aggression, and Ty has made such a huge difference. He’s super knowledgeable, professional, and easy to work with — and he really takes the time to explain what’s going on and how to handle different situations.

We’ve seen major improvements and feel so much more confident on walks now. Ty has helped both our dog and us learn how to work together better. We highly recommend Ty and Bow Wow Behavioral to anyone looking for a great dog trainer in the area!

Ty and Laura both are amazing. I did the 5 week pack and it made a HUGE difference in my rescue's behavior AND I learned so many tips from them and the sessions you can take away and use even when you are done with the sessions! I use the tips every day and I learned an immense amount about my dog! They really take the time to get to know you, your dog, and your dogs quirks and personality and they cater their training style to that and can adapt on the fly! If you are looking for training for any type of  dog and any age, seriously, don't think twice about it and work with them!!!

I had a young dog showing signs of fear-based reactivity to people. I did in-home training sessions. Ty's uses both negative and positive reinforcement methods, but the focus was on becoming the Alpha so that my dog would be less fearful. This included corrections to barking with levels of escalation ("uh-uh", "no", finally spray bottle) and fairly aggressive leash corrections, etc. I have to say it FELT wrong to me to introduce these types of negative corrections to an already very anxious dog, but he seems very knowledgeable. After a month of using his methods, and my dog's fear-based reactivity escalating, my dog ended up biting a friend in the face. I've since learned that if we suppress their "warning signs" dogs will skip the warning and move to the next level of escalation. Levels of escalation was never something we discussed and I'm sad about that. I felt like I was doing the right thing for my dog by reaching out to a behavior specialist before things got worse, but these training methods did not help my dog. Since I've used desensitization training and he's much calmer and happier, and he trusts me because I no longer spray him in the face with water or jerk his leash. I left some of my sessions unused, and know others who have had similar experiences to me.

We boarded with Bow Wow Behavioral this past weekend and were thrilled with it! Communication was timely, consistent updates were provided, and most importantly, it seemed like Arthur had an absolute blast! We will be going back to Bow Wow Behavioral in the future and feel more than comfortable to do so.

TLDR: GO ANYWHERE ELSE FOR BOARDING OR TRAINING. YOUR DOG IS NOT IN GOOD HANDS HERE. LITERALLY GO ANYWHERE ELSE.

I have known Ty since 2020 - I have referred multiple people to him and regret that anyone I know ever sent their dog here either for training or for boarding.

I have used him for both training and boarding and have had horrific experiences with both.

BOARDING: Ty USED to keep dogs in his apartment in the city, give them 1:1 attention, walks, and everything you could expect from a dog sitter. The last time we sent our dog to him for boarding the understanding is that he would stay with Ty at his apartment while we were out of town for 8 days. Instead, one day into his stay - Ty reached out saying that he is too overwhelmed with training to keep our dog and sent him to his parents house in the suburbs. There, they had at least 10 dogs - all in crates in their living room. None of the comforting things that we sent with our dog were given to him. They do NOT walk the dogs. They let them out in the backyard in a small fenced area. All of the pictures and videos of the place look dirty and our dog was given back to us smelling of smoke and clearly terrified. It took us at least a week to get our dog back to his normal self.

TRAINING: When I first got my dog I had Ty over for multiple sessions. Ty is very strange in person - constantly talks to his phone voice notes and clearly not good with people. Once he asked us for a broom to bang on the ground when our dog barks - Ty hit it SO hard that he broke our broom and our dog was terrified of him. Most recently - we purchased a pack of three training sessions from Ty (prior to our traumatic boarding experience) and when we went to book the second session Ty all of a sudden made up a rule that you had to use the sessions within 6 months. We have all the contracts and invoices from our purchase and this new made up rule was not on any of our records.

He is a complete sham and I would not trust him to care or train for any dog.

When my boyfriend and I first adopted our dachshund, Vienna, at just 9 weeks old, we reached out to Bow Wow Behavioral. Ty and Laura have been instrumental in her development over the past year. As dachshunds can be stubborn, we weren’t sure how effective training would be, but finding Ty and Laura ended up being the best decision we could have done for her. Not only did their training tactics work, she also was always so excited to see them! They were always available to provide advice on any concerns or issues that arose with her. When we first started training sessions, Vienna was terrified of the outdoors, but with some consistency and Laura and Ty’s help, by the end of our fifth session, she has become so eager to go even goes potty regularly outside now. Thank you both Ty and Laura! We would recommend them to anyone we know.

Ty, Kyle and Laura are excellent dog trainers. We hired Ty for at home training and we saw results immediately. We then hired them for boarding with training and the pups came home confident, obedient and non reactive to other dogs. I highly recommend their services. We will definitely hire them again for reinforcement training and boarding. 10/10 service.
So warm, thoughtful, and professional. They were so kind to my little pup Snowball :) Laura was such a joy to work with, she was so understanding and attentive to our needs!

I'm so happy I found Bow Wow! The team at Bow Wow are experts and really care.After just one session with Laura, my dog stopped barking at every small sound in the hallway. My anxious dog has always had a difficult time outside in the city, and Laura has made so much progress with him. In addition to training, the boarding care is excellent. I'm so happy to have found a place I can trust to care for my dog while I'm out of town, and the pick up/drop off service makes everything so easy.

After hearing nothing but rave reviews from around the neighborhood about Bow Wow Behavioral, my husband and I decided to take the leap with our new puppy and start training with them a few weeks ago. This has proven to be one of the best decisions we could have made for ourselves, and for our puppy, Sophie! Laura has been nothing but timely, considerate, helpful, and hands on in her approach to training, all qualities that have already bore great results in Sophie's learning and progress. We have found that the private, at-home element has aided in the comfort level of Sophie throughout the process, as well as has helped in establishing her boundaries within our home and space. The price of admission is extremely valuable, and well worth the results. I could not recommend Bow Wow Behavioral more highly to anyone looking to elevate their pup's game behaviorally, or to have their canine companion boarded in a safe, comfortable environment.

My experience with Bow Wow Behavioral has been exceptionally positive. I first had a training session Ty who stopped my Italian Greyhound puppy from eating me and the furniture in a single session, and I have since had a number of training sessions with Laura on leash behavior and recall prompts.  Not only were these sessions effective but my dog Leah loves them both and goes a bit mad with excitement when they arrive at my home. I am a very happy customer.

Had a great experience with Bow Wow Behavioral. Ty really knows dogs and gave me a bunch of tools to work with on commands and leash training. You can tell he really cares and knows his stuff.

We worked on a few things that had been frustrating me and I left feeling way more confident. My pup Macy responded really well to the techniques and I’m already seeing much improvement.

We used Bow Wow Behavorial to address some training needs for our dog Rumi, who was ~8 months old.  The 1 hr training sessions, that are conducted in your own home, are not only convenient but were super helpful in giving us the knowledge and tools we needed to adjust some of Rumi's behavior.  After working with Ty, we immediately noticed a huge difference (no more barking when I'm getting Rumi's breakfast, much less counter surfing, etc).  In the months since we've finished training, we still employ the tactics and training if needed and it always helps us re-center Rumi.  Ty is a very nice, patient, and helpful trainer and he not only trains the dogs but more importantly the owners - which is critical.  I would definitely use Ty again for future training needs!

As a first time dog owner and boarding our 9 month old puppy for the first time, I was very nervous. All my nerves went away as soon as I met Jorge and he sent me the first video within 30 mins of dropping my dog off! He was allowed to sleep where he was comfortable, play in the living room, and Jorge made sure the dog's play styles matched. My dog's tail never stopped wagging in every video which says it all :)

Throughout the 5 day stay, my dog was truly living his best life. I love that there are only 8 dogs max always supervised, in a home setting, with plenty of socialization opps with other dogs. I will no doubt be boarding with Bow Wow in the future!

Highly recommend Bow Wow Behavioral for training your puppy/dog. Laura has been fantastic and helping ensure not only our puppy is more comfortable in her day to day, but us as well. She has provided clear direction and instructions on things we can work on at home and have noticed significant improvement in our dog's behavior since starting our sessions with Bow Wow. We are sending off to boarding/training with Laura and her team and excited for more to come.

Ty and Laura are the absolute BEST! I moved to Chicago with 3 very spoiled little dogs who had never lived in the city or an apartment. I was stressed and didn’t know how I was going to train them to stop barking in the apartment and at every dog on the street. I booked a package and then training camp. My 3 do not bark in the apartment at all and they are proper little city dogs now on their walks. I have also boarded my dogs with them. They are truly loved and cared for. Thank you Bow Wow for training my dogs…and their owner 😊😊

Ty and team were great! Our fur baby learned so much in just one week. The Bow Wow team was so thorough and thoughtful in their daily recaps. Additionally, they took considerable time and care to ensure we understood all commands so we had success at home. Not to mention, they offered support to us should we needed it post training. Highly recommend this crew - they are fabulous.

I absolutely love Bow Wow Behavioral and their whole team. I started working with Ty when my pup, Beatrice, was only 9 weeks old. We were able to establish a really strong foundation of training, including simple commands, leash-training and re-call. Ty gave me really accessible goals and routines to keep up with Bea's training.

2.5 years later and Bow Wow Behavioral is still the only team I trust. I've boarded Bea with them and even added some training to her boarding days, as a refresher course.

In general Bow Wow Behavioral takes a really smart and measured approached to training and a very hands-on approach to boarding. Your dog will always be accompanied, cared for and in good hands. They send helpful updates and my pup returns from her vacation healthy and happy.

I recommend Bow Wow Behavioral to all dog owners and I plan to continue to work with them for as long as possible.
Bow wow has done such an unbelievable job with my watching my dog Frankie! They do a great job of sending consistent updates with photos and videos. I can’t recommend them enough!

Bow Wow Behavioral has been amazing in helping my dog George learn better manners at home. Since working with them, he's been jumping less, pulling less on the leash, and is overall much more responsive and well-behaved. Ty, Kyle, and Laura are fantastic trainers—patient, knowledgeable, and clearly passionate about what they do. I’ve really appreciated their guidance and the noticeable progress George has made. I’m excited to continue working with them to build on everything George has learned so far. Highly recommend them if you're looking for dedicated and effective dog trainers!

We’ve had such a great experience working with Ty as he’s helped us train our puppy, Harley. From the beginning, Ty has been clear, patient, and incredibly knowledgeable—qualities that have made the training process feel both manageable and enjoyable. He has a natural way with dogs, and it’s obvious Harley loves him! We’re so grateful for his guidance and support. Highly recommend!

We had a WONDERFUL experience with Ty and Kyle. We sent our giant pup (1 year old Great Pyrenees/Hound) to BowWow Behavioral for three days of boarding and training in the hopes that they could help him with occasional naughtiness on leash walks and better recall. It’s incredible how much they got done in only three days. He really *learned* with them - I can see him thinking about things differently and also naturally choosing calmer, better walking (vs pulling or being stubborn). They also took the time to teach me some handling skills that allow me to continue on with their good work. I highly recommend them and would send him back any time!

Ty and team are wonderful, caring and gentle! This was the first time we boarded and did training with our fur baby!  I noticed a huge difference on our first walk after picking him up! He is a smart boy, but I have to give all the  credit to the team as we have been unable to break some bad habits he had acquired. We will continue with training with Bow Wow Behavioral as there are more things we would like to work on and we know their methods work!  Thanks Ty!  So glad we found you!!!

Bow wow has done such an unbelievable job with my dog, I can’t recommend them enough! I’ve done socialization camp, in home sessions and board and train. Couldn’t have been happier with all 3 of the options. Ty and his team are very communicative and really want to see my dog succeed. I know I can trust them at any time with her and there is no where else I’d recommend. Bow wow does it right. Would highly recommend ty and his team to anyone that is looking for a trainer. From drop off to pick up, the process is smooth and handled by professionals. Seriously, don’t look any further, bow wow is your answer!
Thank you!

Ty was excellent to work with and helped my puppy gain all the skills I needed him to! He was super friendly and gave me the guidance to be confident in the training process. I would definitely recommend him if you have a puppy.

Our sweet Lucy enjoyed her time with Jorge and Vilma. We knew she was being loved and cared for while we were away. We appreciated the daily updates! We are glad we have found a boarding option that we trust.

Lily Grace was so well cared for by Jorge & Vilma at Bow Wow Boarding! They are so kind and went above and beyond to make my puppy comfortable in their home. Vilma hand fed Lil when she was shy upon arrival. They played with her and gave her lots of love and attention. They were right on time with drop off and pick up. Jorge sent me daily pics & videos which was so comforting to she her doing well while I was away. I was nervous about leaving her with someone but knowing she was in their home with individual TLC and not stuck in a cage in a facility with a lot of other dogs meant the world! I’m so grateful I found them and to know my pup has a loving family to stay with when I travel!
Ty helped train my Bernedoodle puppy - had a really good experience and would recommend!
Thank you!

Leaving Ronnie with someone else used to stress us out, but ever since we started boarding him with Bow Wow Behavioral, it's been a total game-changer. After trying to find our own dogsitter a few times, we decided to go with a place we already trusted since we had worked with Ty on Ronnie's training. Best decision ever.

Ronnie gets so excited when he sees the van pull up, and it's the sweetest thing to watch him run straight to Jorge like an old friend. The at-home pick-up service is a lifesaver, especially since we don't have a car in the city.

One of the best parts? The daily videos of Ronnie living his best life in the yard. He's naturally a shy pup, so we weren’t sure how he'd do in a boarding environment, but he always comes home happy, playful, and totally at ease.

We already knew Ty and his team were amazing trainers, but their boarding service has completely exceeded our expectations. It's clear they truly love and care for the dogs they look after, and that level of trust is priceless.

If you're looking for a reliable, loving, and professional place to board your dog, we can't recommend Bow Wow Behavioral enough!

Nothing but great things to say about Bow Wow Behavioral. Ty is a fantastic trainer who helped me tremendously with my new puppy, and the boarding services were phenomenal! I received daily updates with photos/videos, and it was clear my pup was having the time of his life!

This family-owned business is amazing! Our new pug, Gigi, has had 2 very successful training sessions with Ty in our home. There have been immediate behavior changes that can be maintained using Ty's simple instructions each day. She has also stayed with Jorge & Vilma at the Arlington Heights place. We can tell that she really enjoyed her time there, and they constantly send us videos of her playing in the yard and with other dogs. Everything about Bow Wow Behavioral is excellent!

I’ve used Bow Wow’s boarding service a half dozen times in the last year, and my 11-year-old shih tzu always comes home with a spring in his step from the great time he has there. They are flexible, reasonably priced, and even offer pick up and drop service for an extra $25 (each way). It couldn’t be more convenient. One visit, my dog needed eye drops to be applied five times a day, and he’s not cooperative about drops (he even nips at you when you try to get close to his eye). Jorge and Wilma handled the situation easily, and it was even easier for me to give him the drops once he came home, because they made him so comfortable. I can’t recommend Bow Wow enough - it’s a terrific, friendly and convenient operation.

Our pup Dolly has used Bow Wow Training as well as Boarding services.  We can't say enough how amazing they are!  We love it, Dolly loves it.  They truly treat her as one of their own and we get daily updates while she is boarded and see how much fun she is having.  Best in Class I guarantee.

Bow Wow has always taken such amazing care of Bowie. From his pick up at our house, to daily videos and messages about how he is doing, it is clear that he is so loved and taken care of while we are gone. I highly recommend Bow Wow for anyone’s dog care needs!

I’ve been using Bow Wow Behavioral for boarding, and I couldn’t be happier! They send cute daily video updates of my dog playing with other dogs and having a great time in a huge yard. It’s so reassuring to see how happy she is! I also love the complimentary pick-up and drop-off service for longer stays, plus, they’re always on time and super reliable. I’ll definitely be using their services again and highly recommend them!

We have loved working with Bow Wow Behavioral for training! Ty is an excellent trainer and was able to work with us on behavioral issues with our dog. When our dog needed some training refreshers after our baby was born, Ty worked with us in our home. We have also used BWB for boarding and we know that our dog is in great hands with the team. The team is responsive and sends updates! When they come to pick our dog up, he runs out to greet them so I know that he is well cared for and loved when we’re out of town!

I can't say enough good things about Bow WOW Behavioral!  Ty, George, and Velma have helped us with training and boarding our yorkie for a couple of years now.  We feel so fortunate to have found such amazing and loving people to take care of our senior pooch while we are out of town.  Any guilt is washed away when we see how happy Brownie is to see George!  They offer an amazing service including pickup and drop off.  Best of all, Brownie gets to spend his time in a lovely home with a big yard to explore, a real treat for a city dog!  We get lots of updates during his stay so we feel totally at ease.  Thank you guys for everything!

I waited a few weeks before writing this review because I wanted to give my dog a chance to adjust to being home and walking with me instead of the trainer before making any assumptions. However, now I can say with confidence that I am unimpressed with her training. I took my dog to training for 2 weeks (which was very expensive) in hopes that she would improve in walking on the leash and not reacting to other dogs. Every update I received for the 2 weeks essentially said the same variation of “she’s doing well but still pulling”. When I picked her up she walked on the leash about as well as when I left her. Now I understand that it can take a while for training to stick, but after 2 full weeks at the price I paid, I would expect some change to have happened. Additionally, when I picked my dog up she was sick for a few weeks following her stay and had constant accidents in her kennel, which she never did before.
Our pups came home very well trained and much easier to walk! We loved Ty, Laura, and Kyle’s updates every day!

The trainers here did wonders for my dog. He was very young and needed to learn basic obedience and after a week with Ty and team, it did wonders and really established great fundamentals I can use moving forward. They also take the best pictures and always gave great and detailed daily updates.
Absolutely thrilled that we were able to find Ty, Jorge and Vilma to care for our pup whenever we're out of town. Reliable, caring, and above-and-beyond service.

Bow Wow Behavioral exceeded my expectations in so many ways! I boarded my Maltese with them for three days, and received cute video updates each morning. The videos showed a big yard that the dogs seemed really happy in. Bow Wow was extremely responsive to my questions, and offered a pick-up/drop-off option that was convenient and very prompt. I will definitely be using their boarding service again!

Ty, Laura, and Kyle are devoted, caring and experienced trainers. Cali, 6 months old and very active, went for the 7 day camp and we've been amazed at how thoroughly she's incorporated the basics they taught her. We are so pleased and highly recommend BowWow Behavioral!

We sent our dog Apollo to a week of board & train with Ty, Kyle, and Laura while we were away on our honeymoon.  We were initially trepidatious because we had never done anything like this for our dog.  Now, walking Apollo is like walking with a brand new dog!  They did such a great job working with him on his bad  walking habits.  They also worked with him on his separation anxiety--I was so impressed!  The best part was seeing how happy Apollo was to see Ty and Kyle during our recap lesson; it really lets you know that your dog not only learned, but that the staff at Bow Wow treats the dogs beautifully.  I am definitely going to continue his training with Bow Wow!  he loved it and we love the results!

I took my dog, Snoopy, to Bow Wow for training. It was an experience for both of us. He stayed for two weeks and was trained not to pull on the leash and bark excessively. I know that two weeks is not the ideal amount of time to fully train …

My husband and I are absolutely thrilled with Bow Wow Behavioral from short overnight stays with Lee, to the 21days board and train with Ty and Laura. They've done an exceptional job with our Sammy. The staff is not only highly skilled but …

Ty and Laura were incredible with our poodle pointer puppy, Clementine. After a week of training she now walks on a leash like a dream and has stopped jumping up to greet. I found Bow Wow to be responsive, reasonable, and I’d recommend them without hesitation.
